cmsy_forecast(): 不同捕捞情景下的CMSY++预测

Source: vignettes/articles/zh/reference/cmsy_forecast.Rmd
cmsy_forecast.Rmd

英文原页：cmsy_forecast()

说明

本函数根据cmsy_run()的结果，在不同捕捞死亡率情景（默认为0.5、0.6、0.8和0.95倍Fmsy，与Froese等（2018）相同，以及最后一年的捕捞死亡率）或固定渔获量下对每个种群向前预测，并绘制预测的B/Bmsy和渔获量。

English

This function projects each stock forward from the results of cmsy_run() under fishing mortality scenarios (by default 0.5, 0.6, 0.8 and 0.95 Fmsy, as in Froese et al. 2018, and the last-year fishing mortality) or constant catches, and draws the projected B/Bmsy and catch.

用法 

cmsy_forecast(
  result,
  stocks = NULL,
  years = 10,
  f = c(0.5, 0.6, 0.8, 0.95),
  status_quo = TRUE,
  catch = NULL,
  sigma = 0.1,
  seed = NULL,
  plot = TRUE,
  table = TRUE,
  lang = NULL,
  annotations = getOption("faofishingreport.cmsy_annotations", FALSE),
  pptx = getOption("faofishingreport.pptx", FALSE),
  silent = fao_setting("silent")
)

参数

result
cmsy_run()的结果。
English The result of cmsy_run().
stocks
要预测的种群（可选）：Stock标识，或物种的FAO英文或中文名称、学名或FAO三字母代码。默认为NULL，即所有已运行的种群。
English Optional stocks to project: Stock identifiers or species, by English or Chinese FAO name, scientific name or FAO 3-alpha code. Default is NULL, all stocks that ran.
years
在各种群最后一年中最晚的一年之后预测的年数。默认为10。
English Number of years to project after the latest last year of the stocks. Default is 10.
f
以Fmsy倍数表示的捕捞死亡率情景。默认为c(0.5, 0.6, 0.8, 0.95)。
English Fishing mortality scenarios as multiples of Fmsy. Default is c(0.5, 0.6, 0.8, 0.95).
status_quo
逻辑值。为TRUE（默认）时，还按最后一年的捕捞死亡率进行预测。
English A logical value. If TRUE (default), the last-year fishing mortality is also projected.
catch
要预测的固定渔获量（可选），单位为吨/年（例如最后一年的渔获量）。
English Optional constant catches to project, in tonnes per year (e.g. the last-year catch).
sigma
对数正态过程误差的标准差。默认为0.1。
English Standard deviation of the lognormal process error. Default is 0.1.
seed
随机数种子（可选）。
English Optional random seed.
plot, table
是否保存图表（figures/png/cmsy/<stock>/forecast.png和figures/png/cmsy/summary/forecast_share.png）和表格（tables/cmsy/）。默认为TRUE。
English Whether charts (figures/png/cmsy/<stock>/forecast.png and figures/png/cmsy/summary/forecast_share.png) and the table (tables/cmsy/) are saved. Default is TRUE.
lang
图表文字和名称的语言：“en”（英文）、“zh”（中文）或”both”（中英双语）。默认为NULL，即使用fao_settings()设置的语言（未更改时为”en”）。
English The language of the chart text and names: “en” (English), “zh” (Chinese) or “both” (Chinese and English). Default is NULL, which uses the language set with fao_settings() (“en” unless changed).
annotations
在坐标轴标题和坐标轴标签之外添加的文字：FALSE（默认）不添加，TRUE全部添加，或”title”、“subtitle”、“caption”、“legend”和”labels”（图内文字）中的任意几项。可以用options(faofishingreport.cmsy_annotations = TRUE)更改本次R会话的默认值。
English The text added to the axis titles and labels: FALSE (default) none, TRUE all, or any of “title”, “subtitle”, “caption”, “legend” and “labels” (text inside the chart). The default can be changed for the session with options(faofishingreport.cmsy_annotations = TRUE).
pptx
逻辑值。为TRUE时，图表还另存为可编辑的PowerPoint文件，保存在figures/pptx/cmsy/<stock>/和figures/pptx/cmsy/summary/。默认为FALSE，可以用fao_settings(pptx = TRUE)为所有函数统一更改。
English A logical value. If TRUE, the charts are also saved as editable PowerPoint files in figures/pptx/cmsy/<stock>/ and figures/pptx/cmsy/summary/. Default is FALSE, which can be changed for all functions with fao_settings(pptx = TRUE).
silent
逻辑值。为FALSE（默认）时，用进度条显示已完成预测的种群数；为TRUE时不输出任何内容。可以用fao_settings(silent = TRUE)更改本次R会话的默认值。
English A logical value. If FALSE (default), a progress bar shows how many stocks have been projected. If TRUE, nothing is printed. The default can be changed for the session with fao_settings(silent = TRUE).

返回值

以不可见方式返回一个列表，包含projection（按种群、情景和年份：B/Bmsy、F/Fmsy和渔获量的中位数及95%置信限，以及B至少达到Bmsy的概率）和share（按情景和年份：处于或高于Bmsy的种群所占比例及其95%置信限，以及种群数）。

English

Invisibly, a list with projection (by stock, scenario and year: median B/Bmsy, F/Fmsy and catch with 95% limits, and the probability that B is at least Bmsy) and share (by scenario and year: share of stocks at or above Bmsy, with 95% limits, and the number of stocks).

详细说明

CMSY++16.R本身没有预测功能，因此这里用CMSY++的模型本身进行预测：生产力在B/k = 0.25以下线性下降的Schaefer剩余产量模型（CMSY++16.R和Froese等，2023），从本次运行中r、k和最后一年B/k的后验抽样值（来自相同的MCMC迭代）出发，并加入标准差为sigma的对数正态过程误差（默认为0.1，即CMSY++16.R给其未使用的设置sigmaR的值；CMSY++模型本身估计其过程误差）。与CMSY++相同，某一年的生物量是该年捕捞之前的生物量，F是渔获量除以该生物量，F/Fmsy所用的Fmsy在生物量低于Bmsy的一半时线性降低（CMSY++16.R）。保留数据最后一年的渔获量，因此下一年的生物量即为CMSY++模型给出的生物量；各情景从预测的第一年起设定渔获量。在F情景中，渔获量等于情景的F乘以同一年的生物量，因此F/Fmsy等于情景值。

数据结束年份不同的种群，各自从其最后一年预测到同一个最终年份（各种群最后一年中最晚的一年加上years）；处于或高于Bmsy的种群所占比例从这一最晚的最后一年起给出，此时每个种群都有值。

English

CMSY++16.R has no projection, so it is done here with the CMSY++ model itself: the Schaefer surplus-production model in which productivity declines linearly below B/k = 0.25 (CMSY++16.R and Froese et al. 2023), started from the posterior draws of r, k and last-year B/k of the run (which come from the same MCMC iterations), with lognormal process error of standard deviation sigma (0.1 by default, the value CMSY++16.R gives to its unused setting sigmaR; the CMSY++ model itself estimates its process error). As in CMSY++, the biomass of a year is the biomass before the catch of that year, F is the catch divided by that biomass, and F/Fmsy uses an Fmsy reduced linearly below half of Bmsy (CMSY++16.R). The catch of the last year of the data is kept, so the biomass of the next year is that of the CMSY++ model; the scenarios set the catch from the first projected year on. In the F scenarios the catch is the scenario F times the biomass of the same year, so F/Fmsy is the scenario value.

Stocks whose data end in different years are each projected from their own last year to the same final year (the latest last year plus years); the share of stocks at or above Bmsy is given from the latest last year on, when every stock has a value.

参考文献

Froese, R., Winker, H., Coro, G., Demirel, N., Tsikliras, A.C., Dimarchopoulou, D., Scarcella, G., Quaas, M. and Matz-Lueck, N. (2018). Status and rebuilding of European fisheries. Marine Policy 93: 159-170. doi:10.1016/j.marpol.2018.04.018

Froese, R., Winker, H., Coro, G., Palomares, M.L.D., Tsikliras, A.C., Dimarchopoulou, D., Touloumis, K., Demirel, N., Vianna, G.M.S., Scarcella, G., Schijns, R., Liang, C. and Pauly, D. (2023). New developments in the analysis of catch time series as the basis for fish stock assessments: the CMSY++ method. Acta Ichthyologica et Piscatoria 53: 173-189. doi:10.3897/aiep.53.105910

示例 

# result <- cmsy_run(...), see cmsy_run()

# Default scenarios: 0.5, 0.6, 0.8 and 0.95 Fmsy, and the last-year fishing mortality
projection <- cmsy_forecast(result, seed = 1)

# Twenty years, two F scenarios and a constant catch of 50,000 t, in Chinese
projection <- cmsy_forecast(result, years = 20, f = c(0.8, 1), catch = 50000, seed = 1, lang = "zh")
last <- projection$projection[projection$projection$Year == max(projection$projection$Year), ]
last[, c("Stock", "scenario_label", "B_Bmsy", "B_Bmsy_lcl", "B_Bmsy_ucl", "p_above_bmsy")]

# Share of the stocks at or above Bmsy (when several stocks were run)
projection$share
